sourceFile: 30. TIU C11-20  Report test find reason NG NG function high 2026.01.02_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft has citeable rows but the changed-factor and outcome grouping are not reliable for final evidence.
issues: One changed factor incorrectly combines many unrelated tests and dates.
Baselines are pooled across different sections instead of matched per experiment.
Some cited rows are headers or context, not condition evidence.
Measurement outcomes are artifacts from defect tables and specs are misapplied.
Several valid test rows, including totals and second rounds, are incompletely grouped.
correctionPlan: Split cases by report section or distinct experiment context.
Create separate changed factors for dry time, UV, bond amount, VP A2, forming position, tray stock, rubber cleaning, heat temperature, and open-test use.
Match each test only to the normal row in the same table/date/round context.
Remove artifact measurement stats from defect count tables unless a true measurement table is used.
Keep only evidence rows that directly support each condition and result.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist, but they are insufficient because grouping and relevance are not verified.
